Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: PulseQueue
Punchline: Latest input wins. Exact action. Responsive timing.
Description: A strict smart input buffer with optional keyboard-only exact-action Turbo, newest-input replacement, and fail-closed NoClippy, ReAction, and MOAction compatibility.
Changelog: Turbo live-test fix: raw-key hold ownership now survives typematic/logical gaps, direct and strictly verified single-action macros share one immutable exact-action path, and original/one-shot/pulse acknowledgement barriers prevent overtaking or retries. Macro Turbo is a separate opt-in; ReAction Turbo Hotbars and Macro Queue must stay off.
